description: This file defines the DefaultTimesheetAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for retrieving the default timesheet data for a specified employee, possibly filtered by date. It handles request parameters, interacts with the timesheet service, creates default timesheet objects if none are found, and returns the data wrapped in a resource result, following the project's API structure.
